requirements.text: The system shall be built using C# and .NET 6.
The system shall use Entity Framework Core for data persistence.
The database shall be SQL Server LocalDB.
The frontend shall use Razor Views (.cshtml).
The frontend shall use Knockout.js for client-side view models and data binding.
The frontend shall use jQuery.
The system shall use DataTables for displaying list data.
The UI framework shall be Bootstrap 5.
The system shall use Dependency Injection.
All CRUD operations must use AJAX to avoid full page refreshes.
The solution must contain a project named HRMS.Data responsible only for persistence.
The HRMS.Data project must contain the DbContext and EF Configurations.
The HRMS.Data project must contain EF Core Migrations.
The solution must contain a project for shared models containing Entities, DTOs, and ViewModels.
The solution must contain an application business layer project for logic, validation, and CRUD.
The business layer project must communicate with HRMS.Data.
The solution must contain a Web project responsible for background processing using Quartz Jobs.
The solution must contain a web application project containing Controllers and Razor Views.
The UI must follow a pattern where every page consists of a Controller, a .cshtml view, and a ViewModel.js.
Knockout ViewModels must expose load, save, update, delete, search, reset, refresh, export, import, and validate methods.
DataTables must support sorting, paging, searching, and filtering.
The system must implement role-based authentication.
Controllers must validate permissions before rendering pages.
Services must validate permissions for sensitive operations.
Database schema management must be handled through EF Migrations only.
The system must include a Dashboard module.
The system must include an Employee management module.
The system must include a Department management module.
The system must include an Attendance tracking module.
The system must include a Payroll module.
The system must include Audit Logs and Notification modules.
Files must be organized into folders segregated by business domain.
The project must include a README.md file at the root with setup and architecture documentation.
The project shall exclude React, Angular, Vue, and Blazor frameworks.
The project shall exclude MediatR, CQRS, and Clean/Onion Architecture patterns.
